# ChineseSnacks - Chinese Street Food Travel Guide

ChineseSnacks is a practical Chinese street food guide covering Beijing, Chengdu, Xi an, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Chongqing. Every snack includes where to eat, what to pay, and how to order in Chinese.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://chinese-snacks.com/): Complete overview of Chinese street snacks with quiz, seasonal calendar, and ordering phrases.
- [All Snacks](https://chinese-snacks.com/snacks/): Directory of 20+ Chinese snacks with prices and locations.
- [By City](https://chinese-snacks.com/cities/): Browse snacks by city - Beijing, Chengdu, Xi an, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Chongqing.
- [Snack Streets](https://chinese-snacks.com/snack-streets/): Interactive map of Chinas best snack streets and night markets.
- [Ordering Phrases](https://chinese-snacks.com/phrases/): Essential Chinese phrases for ordering street food.
- [Safety Guide](https://chinese-snacks.com/safety/): Practical tips for eating street food safely in China.
- [Vegetarian Guide](https://chinese-snacks.com/vegetarian/): Complete guide to vegetarian and vegan Chinese street snacks.
- [Bringing Snacks Home](https://chinese-snacks.com/bring-home/): Customs rules and packaging tips for bringing Chinese snacks home.
- [About](https://chinese-snacks.com/about/): How ChineseSnacks verifies every recommendation.

## Optional
